{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"row","sql":"SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT m.id, m.code, m.name, m.model, m.agent_model AS \"agentModel\", m.serial_no AS \"serialNo\", m.agent_serial AS \"agentSerial\", m.status, m.status_code AS \"statusCode\", m.online, m.ingredient_level AS \"ingredientLevel\", m.sales_today AS \"salesToday\", m.errors_open AS \"errorsOpen\", m.object_path AS \"objectPath\", m.object_name AS \"objectName\", m.agg_path AS \"aggPath\", m.registry_id AS \"registryId\", m.connector, m.last_seen_at AS \"lastSeenAt\", (SELECT name FROM cg_site s WHERE s.id = m.site_id) AS \"siteName\", (SELECT code FROM cg_site s WHERE s.id = m.site_id) AS \"siteCode\", (SELECT r.name FROM cg_site s JOIN cg_region r ON r.id = s.region_id WHERE s.id = m.site_id) AS region FROM cg_machine m WHERE m.id = ?) t","params":["${input.id}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"row","sql":"SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (
  SELECT i.id, i.title, i.description, i.severity, i.status, i.assignee,
    i.agg_incident_id AS "aggIncidentId",
    i.created_at AS "createdAt", i.updated_at AS "updatedAt", i.due_at AS "dueAt", i.closed_at AS "closedAt",
    i.machine_id AS "machineId",
    (SELECT code FROM cg_machine m WHERE m.id = i.machine_id) AS "machineCode",
    (SELECT name FROM cg_machine m WHERE m.id = i.machine_id) AS "machineName"
  FROM cg_incident i
  WHERE (COALESCE(?, '') = '' OR i.status = ?)
  ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
) t","params":["${input.status}","${input.status}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"row","sql":"SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT s.id, s.code, s.name, s.model_family AS \"modelFamily\", r.name AS region, s.status, (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM cg_machine m WHERE m.site_id = s.id) AS \"machineCount\" FROM cg_site s LEFT JOIN cg_region r ON r.id = s.region_id ORDER BY s.code) t"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"row","sql":"SELECT json_build_object('screens', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id, name, title, category, CASE category WHEN 'operator' THEN 'Оператор' WHEN 'guest' THEN 'Гость' WHEN 'analytics' THEN 'Аналитика' WHEN 'report' THEN 'Отчёт' WHEN 'admin' THEN 'Админ' WHEN 'modal' THEN 'Модалка' WHEN 'shell' THEN 'Оболочка' WHEN 'legacy' THEN 'Legacy' ELSE category END AS \"categoryLabel\", agg_path AS \"aggPath\", react_route AS \"reactRoute\", migration_status AS status, ispf_target AS \"ispfTarget\" FROM cg_agg_screen ORDER BY category, name) t), 'models', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id, name, role, kind, kind_label AS \"kindLabel\", category, agg_path AS \"aggPath\", migration_status AS status, ispf_target AS \"ispfTarget\" FROM cg_agg_model ORDER BY CASE category WHEN 'coffegate' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CASE kind WHEN 'manager' THEN 1 WHEN 'driver' THEN 2 WHEN 'presenter' THEN 3 WHEN 'ui' THEN 4 WHEN 'domain' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, name) t), 'functions', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id, source, CASE source WHEN 'bff' THEN 'BFF Hub' WHEN 'domain' THEN 'Доменная' ELSE source END AS \"sourceLabel\", owner, name, role, migration_status AS status, ispf_target AS \"ispfTarget\" FROM cg_agg_function ORDER BY CASE source WHEN 'bff' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, name) t))::text AS rows"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"row","sql":"SELECT json_build_object('summary', json_build_object('screens', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cg_agg_screen), 'screensMapped', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cg_agg_screen WHERE migration_status = 'mapped'), 'models', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cg_agg_model), 'modelsCg', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cg_agg_model WHERE category = 'coffegate'), 'modelsExternal', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cg_agg_model WHERE category = 'other'), 'functions', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cg_agg_function), 'functionsBff', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cg_agg_function WHERE source = 'bff'), 'functionsDomain', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cg_agg_function WHERE source = 'domain'), 'machines', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cg_machine)), 'modelsByKind', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT kind, kind_label AS \"kindLabel\", COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM cg_agg_model GROUP BY kind, kind_label ORDER BY CASE kind WHEN 'manager' THEN 1 WHEN 'driver' THEN 2 WHEN 'presenter' THEN 3 WHEN 'ui' THEN 4 WHEN 'domain' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END) t), 'screensByCategory', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT category, CASE category WHEN 'operator' THEN 'Оператор' WHEN 'guest' THEN 'Гость' WHEN 'analytics' THEN 'Аналитика' WHEN 'report' THEN 'Отчёт' WHEN 'admin' THEN 'Админ' WHEN 'modal' THEN 'Модалка' WHEN 'shell' THEN 'Оболочка' WHEN 'legacy' THEN 'Legacy' ELSE category END AS \"categoryLabel\", COUNT(*)::int AS count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE migration_status = 'mapped')::int AS mapped FROM cg_agg_screen GROUP BY category ORDER BY category) t), 'functionsBySource', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT source, CASE source WHEN 'bff' THEN 'BFF Hub' WHEN 'domain' THEN 'Доменная' ELSE source END AS \"sourceLabel\", COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM cg_agg_function GROUP BY source ORDER BY CASE source WHEN 'bff' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) t))::text AS rows"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"ids","sql":"SELECT
              'inc-' || to_char(NOW(),'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || substr(md5(random()::text),1,8) AS id,
              'ev-' || to_char(NOW(),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') || '-' || substr(md5(random()::text),1,6) AS evid"},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO cg_incident (
                id, machine_id, agg_incident_id, title, description, severity, status, assignee, created_at, updated_at
              ) VALUES (
                ?, NULLIF(?,''), '', ?, COALESCE(NULLIF(?,''), ''),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(?,''), 'warning'), 'open', NULLIF(?,''), NOW(), NOW()
              )","params":["${ids.id}","${input.machine_id}","${input.title}","${input.description}","${input.severity}","${input.assignee}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO cg_incident_event (id, incident_id, at, actor, action, from_status, to_status, note)
              VALUES (?, ?, NOW(), COALESCE(NULLIF(?,''),'operator'), 'created', NULL, 'open', COALESCE(NULLIF(?,''), 'Заявка создана'))","params":["${ids.evid}","${ids.id}","${input.actor}","${input.description}"]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"row","sql":"SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (
              SELECT i.id, i.title, i.description, i.severity, i.status, i.assignee,
                i.created_at AS "createdAt", i.updated_at AS "updatedAt",
                i.machine_id AS "machineId",
                (SELECT code FROM cg_machine m WHERE m.id = i.machine_id) AS "machineCode",
                (SELECT name FROM cg_machine m WHERE m.id = i.machine_id) AS "machineName"
              FROM cg_incident i WHERE i.id = ?
            ) t","params":["${ids.id}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE cg_incident SET
              status = COALESCE(NULLIF(?,''), status),
              assignee = COALESCE(NULLIF(?,''), assignee),
              updated_at = NOW(),
              closed_at = CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(?,''), status) IN ('closed','resolved') THEN COALESCE(closed_at, NOW())
                ELSE closed_at
              END
            WHERE id = ?","params":["${input.status}","${input.assignee}","${input.status}","${input.id}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO cg_incident_event (id, incident_id, at, actor, action, from_status, to_status, note)

                ?, NOW(), COALESCE(NULLIF(?,''),'operator'), 'status',
                NULLIF(?,''),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(?,''), (SELECT status FROM cg_incident WHERE id = ?)),
                COALESCE(NULLIF(?,''),'')
              )","params":["${input.id}","${input.actor}","${input.from_status}","${input.status}","${input.id}","${input.note}"]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"row","sql":"SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (
              SELECT i.id, i.title, i.description, i.severity, i.status, i.assignee,
                i.created_at AS "createdAt", i.updated_at AS "updatedAt", i.closed_at AS "closedAt",
                i.machine_id AS "machineId",
                (SELECT code FROM cg_machine m WHERE m.id = i.machine_id) AS "machineCode",
                (SELECT name FROM cg_machine m WHERE m.id = i.machine_id) AS "machineName"
              FROM cg_incident i WHERE i.id = ?
            ) t","params":["${input.id}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"row","sql":"SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (
              SELECT e.id, e.incident_id AS "incidentId", e.at, e.actor, e.action,

reports.title: Обзор парка

reports.title: Автоматы
reports.query: SELECT m.code, m.name, m.model, m.serial_no, CASE WHEN m.online THEN 'online' ELSE 'offline' END AS online, m.status, m.errors_open, s.name AS site_name, m.object_name FROM cg_machine m LEFT JOIN cg_site s ON s.id = m.site_id ORDER BY m.code

reports.title: Площадки
reports.description: Площадки и линейки аппаратов (WMF / F2) — не путать с доменными моделями
reports.query: SELECT s.code, s.name, s.model_family AS machine_line, r.name AS region, s.status, (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM cg_machine m WHERE m.site_id = s.id) AS machines FROM cg_site s LEFT JOIN cg_region r ON r.id = s.region_id ORDER BY s.code

reports.title: Заявки
reports.query: SELECT i.id, i.title, i.severity, i.status, m.code AS machine_code, m.name AS machine_name, i.created_at FROM cg_incident i LEFT JOIN cg_machine m ON m.id = i.machine_id ORDER BY i.created_at DESC

reports.title: Каталог экранов
reports.description: Таблица экранов UI — отдельно от дашборда «Экраны приложения»
reports.query: SELECT name, title, CASE category WHEN 'operator' THEN 'Оператор' WHEN 'guest' THEN 'Гость' WHEN 'analytics' THEN 'Аналитика' WHEN 'report' THEN 'Отчёт' WHEN 'admin' THEN 'Админ' WHEN 'modal' THEN 'Модалка' WHEN 'shell' THEN 'Оболочка' WHEN 'legacy' THEN 'Legacy' ELSE category END AS category_label, category, CASE migration_status WHEN 'mapped' THEN 'active' WHEN 'partial' THEN 'active' WHEN 'stub' THEN 'planned' WHEN 'pending' THEN 'planned' WHEN 'deferred' THEN 'archived' ELSE migration_status END AS status, COALESCE(NULLIF(ispf_target, ''), 'root.platform.dashboards.coffegate-' || name) AS entity FROM cg_agg_screen ORDER BY CASE migration_status WHEN 'mapped' THEN 1 WHEN 'partial' THEN 2 WHEN 'stub' THEN 3 WHEN 'pending' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, category, name

reports.title: Каталог доменных моделей
reports.description: Таблица доменных моделей — отдельно от дашборда «Доменные модели» и линеек КМ
reports.query: SELECT name, kind_label AS kind, role, category, CASE migration_status WHEN 'mapped' THEN 'active' WHEN 'partial' THEN 'active' WHEN 'stub' THEN 'planned' WHEN 'pending' THEN 'planned' WHEN 'out-of-scope' THEN 'external' ELSE migration_status END AS status, COALESCE(NULLIF(ispf_target, ''), name) AS entity FROM cg_agg_model ORDER BY CASE category WHEN 'coffegate' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CASE kind WHEN 'manager' THEN 1 WHEN 'driver' THEN 2 WHEN 'presenter' THEN 3 WHEN 'ui' THEN 4 WHEN 'domain' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, CASE migration_status WHEN 'mapped' THEN 1 WHEN 'partial' THEN 2 WHEN 'stub' THEN 3 WHEN 'pending' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, name

reports.title: Каталог функций
reports.description: Таблица BFF Hub и доменных функций — отдельно от дашборда «Функции Hub»
reports.query: SELECT CASE source WHEN 'bff' THEN 'BFF Hub' WHEN 'domain' THEN 'Доменная' ELSE source END AS source_label, source, owner, name, role, CASE migration_status WHEN 'mapped' THEN 'active' WHEN 'active' THEN 'active' WHEN 'partial' THEN 'active' WHEN 'stub' THEN 'planned' WHEN 'pending' THEN 'planned' ELSE migration_status END AS status, COALESCE(NULLIF(ispf_target, ''), name) AS entity FROM cg_agg_function ORDER BY CASE source WHEN 'bff' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, owner, name
